name: set_regex
description: Change a regex's pattern and flags.

name: add_regex
description: Add a regex; it gets the next free id (r1, r2, …).

name: remove_regex
description: Remove a regex and the expectations that name it.

name: reorder_regexes
description: Move a regex to a position (0 is first).

name: add_text
description: Add a text to test against; it gets the next free id (t1, t2, …).

name: reorder_texts
description: Move a text to a position (0 is first).

name: set_expectation
description: Say whether a regex should match a text: match, no-match, or none to clear it.

name: grid
description: Every text × regex: whether the regex matches, what is expected and whether that passes.

name: explain_matches
description: Where a regex matches a text: each match's position, text and capture groups.
